messages:
maria: quick heads-up — canary for q4b-small-int4 is flaking on our golden set v2.0, precision down ~4% on promptbank/codegen slice. noticed after yesterday's quant rollout.
jonathan: ugh. which slice exactly? is this across all prompts or a focused subset?
maria: mostly codegen long-contexts and a couple of multi-turn customer-support prompts. sample ids: 8a3f... and b12c... (will paste full list after initial triage).
priya: can you paste the failing examples? also, did the deploy include any tokenizer changes?
maria: no tokenizer changes. failing examples: 
```
# example 8a3f...
input: "def compute(x):" + long prompt 
expected: complete function + docstring
q4b-small-int4 output: truncated/incomplete, returns helper name instead of full body
```
leo: got it. this smells like quant-induced attention kernel break on long ctx. we saw similar with qx-mini last month.
annie: label-ops note: our labeling queue spiked when we re-ran golden regen yesterday — labeler throughput dropped and we have 2k pending. we should avoid blasting the queue with re-evals until we confirm which examples to relabel. :grimacing:
ben: can we run a targeted A/B on just the failing prompts (small batch) against the float baseline and q4b-small-int4? I'd rather not roll everything back yet.
labelbot: automated check: top 250 golden examples re-ranked; 18 failures flagged as new regression vs baseline. Full list stored at s3://redwood-canary/q4b-small-int4/regressions-1705123456.csv
jonathan: @labelbot thanks — @annie can you freeze any automatic golden regeneration jobs for the next 24h? we don't want noisy label churn.
annie: freezing scheduled jobs now. I'll also throttle the relabel campaign.
priya: two action items: (1) create a minimal repro harness for the two failing ids and run with kernel debug flags; (2) audit sampling logic — ensure dedupe didn't surface near-duplicate variants that exaggerate the regression.
leo: i'll run the kernel debug + KV cache trace on the repro harness. estimated 45m. posting logs when done.
maria: TY. also, note we discovered seedset overlap between the promptbank and the canary holdout — about 1.8% overlap after recent ingest; that could explain amplification. I'm attaching the overlap diff.
ben: overlap is small but worth pruning. propose: remove duplicates, re-evaluate 1000-sample random holdout, and run the A/B. if regression persists, plan rollback of q4b-small-int4 for codegen routes.
priya: agree. @maria can you open a small curation ticket listing the exact samples to prune + a golden-sync note? I'll coordinate labelers if we need human relabel.
maria: ticket opened: CUR-5101 with sample list and reasoning. link: https://kanban.redwood/c/5101
labelbot: note: relabel budget available: 500 tasks/day for priority=high. request via CUR-5101 to ramp.
jonathan: also check routing — canary was routed 10% traffic on codegen model; we can drop to 1% while debugging to limit customer impact. ops-bot: can you adjust canary weight to 1%?
ops-bot: autoscaling/deploy-bot acknowledged. Reducing canary weight for q4b-small-int4 on codegen to 1% now.
leo: kernel debug trace done, uploaded logs to /tmp/q4b-debug-1705123456.log. initial signal: kv-cache miss patterns on long-prefixes + one fused attention kernel producing NaN probabilities under extreme int4 scaling.
priya: if it's NaN under int4, we should try elevation to int8 (q8x) or fallback to float32 for affected layers and re-run. can we create two variants? q4b-small-int4 and q4b-small-hybrid-int8?
ben: create variant -> run A/B on the same sample set. if hybrid fixes >90% of regressions, we keep q4b for non-codegen routes and hybrid for codegen.
annie: relabelers on standby if we need human judgments. remind: don't run a full golden regen until we confirm dedupe/overlap cleanup.
maria: roadmap update: will coordinate the dedupe prune today, leo will test hybrid variant, priya will run sample-level audits, jonathan + ops will keep canary low. back here in ~3h with results. :thumbsup:
jonathan: thanks — appreciate the quick loop.
annie: thanks all, pausing wide relabel jobs. :lock:
labelbot: logged regression alert to incident tracker INC-1705123456 (severity: low-medium).
maria: update 3h later — hybrid variant recovered 3.6% precision vs baseline (close to float), overlap prune removed 1.8% amplification. planning targeted relabel of 120 examples flagged as borderline. scheduling now.
jonathan: next steps look good. let's capture the quant-config diff and add to onboarding checklist to prevent future surprise regressions (kv-cache tests + small-longctx canaries).
maria: noted — adding checklist item: "run KV-cache long-prefix synthetic tests + kernel NaN scan" to model-onboard-runbook.
ben: OK to close thread when relabeling done and A/B passes >95%?
priya: yes. keep monitoring for 48h after ramp.
maria: closing loop later. thanks everyone.
